---
title: Personalized Dose Finding
---

This tutorial uses orthoDr 2.0.0. See [Get Started](get-started.html) for
installation and the complete R script.

```{r load-package, eval=FALSE}
library(orthoDr)
```

```{r guide, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
source(rprojroot::find_package_root_file("tools", "pkgdown-guide.R"), local = TRUE)
cat(guide_section("Learn a personalized dose and predict"), sep = "\n")
```

## Next steps

See `orthoDr_pdose()` for candidate grids, bandwidths, initialization, and
regularization, and the numerical stopping criteria. The
[method paper](https://doi.org/10.1093/biomet/asaa087) explains the distinction
between direct and pseudo-direct learning and their assumptions.
